description: This file contains functions for resetting and calculating codebook gain averages in an AMR speech codec, including handling of LSP differences, background noise smoothing, and gain trajectory smoothing.

methods.name: Cb_gain_average_reset
methods.description: Resets the state memory for codebook gain averaging, initializing history and hangover variables to zero.

methods.name: Cb_gain_average
methods.description: Calculates a smoothed codebook gain based on current gain, LSP differences, background noise, and error conditions, updating internal state accordingly.
